positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led enhancements and ongoing maintenance of a wireless sales application built using Java, Spring Boot, React, and Angular, following a microservices architecture, while leveraging GitHub Copilot to accelerate development cycles and leading a team of 4–6 developers.
Engineered and integrated fraud mitigation capabilities, including Heightened Authentication, SIM Freeze, and Photo ID verification using the Mitek SDK, reducing SIM swap and identity fraud incidents by approximately 99%.
- Designed and implemented an application to onboard Small and Medium Business (SMB) wireless customers, significantly streamlining the customer acquisition process.
- Orchestrated customer onboarding and Transfer of Service workflows using Pega, enabling case-based processing, reuse of customer interactions, and reducing onboarding time by over 40% while improving overall customer experience.
- Leveraged AWS serverless services such as S3 and Lambda to implement scalable features within the customer onboarding process.
- Automated workflow management for Transfer of Service Agreements for wireline customers using Pega, reducing average turnaround time from over 200 days to less than 120 days.
- Integrated AI-powered document verification for business proof validation, supporting onboarding for more than 35,000 new customers and improving security and regulatory compliance.
- Enhanced and maintained transactional frameworks supporting wireless services for business and enterprise customers across assisted sales channels, improving system reliability and scalability.
- Optimized Transfer of Service (ToS) transactions from Consumer to Business wireless accounts, reducing fallout rates by over 98% and enabling faster processing through assisted channels.
- Improved application performance and user experience for assisted wireless sales channels, resulting in an approximately 80% reduction in daily production support tickets.
positions.insights: Spring Boot, Core Java and +18 skills

positions.title: Technology Specialist
positions.description:
As a tech specialist, I worked with teams in USA, Canada, Germany and India to deliver new capabilities in the Order Management Systems for Century Link and Verizon. As a part of my work, I worked with the teams to:
- Implement new capabilities in Verizon's wireline quoting and order management application using Ericsson Order Care 16.1, enhancing system functionality.
- Drive performance improvements in quoting flows for Verizon's wireline customers, resulting in faster and more reliable operations.
- Led migration from Ericsson Order Care 14.2 to 16.1 for Verizon's wireline quoting and ordering application, ensuring seamless transition and minimal downtime.
- Developed quoting and ordering applications for Century Link's wireline customers using Ericsson Order Care 14.2, expanding business capabilities.
- Utilized various Ericsson Order Care components, including Documents, Finders, User Process, Global Process, User Interface, and Basket, to deliver comprehensive solutions.

positions.title: Assistant Consultant
positions.description:
As a software developer, I worked with teams in India and USA to deliver new capabilities in the Order Management Systems for Comcast. As a part of my work, I led a team of 4 developers to:
- Migrate ordering applications from Ericsson Order Care 4.1 to Ericsson Order Care 5.2
- Design and implement ordering application to place self install orders to replace end-of-life legacy video devices and routers with advanced new devices
- Migration of ordering application from Ericsson's license based product to an application using open source technologies and frameworks using Java, ActiveMQ, MongoDB, Spring Boot, AngularJS, etc.

positions.title: IT Analyst
positions.description:
As a software developer, I worked with teams in India and USA to deliver new capabilities in the Order Management Systems for Comcast. As a part of my work, I worked with the teams to:
- Get trained on and use Ericsson Order Care 4.1 suite to manage 4 applications built using Ericsson's product
- Design and develop new enhancements in the centralized order repository and worklisting platform, which integrated with over 10 applications in the Order Management ecosystem
- Design and develop new enhancements in ordering application to place self install orders for DTA (Digital to Analog) adapters
- Create PL/SQL scripts for account migration activities across billing systems
- Design and develop new enhancements in ordering application to replace end-of-life legacy video devices with advanced new devices

positions.title: Assistant Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a software developer, I worked with teams across multiple countries, including India, China, Macau, Philippines and Guatemala to deliver solutions for Revenue Assurance, Fraud Management and Self Service Portal for telecom companies in Asia and Latin America. As a part of my work, I worked with the teams to:
- Build a self-service portal for Companhia de Telecomunicacoes, Macau, enabling customers to manage fixed line, internet, and wireless services online.
- Develop Revenue Assurance applications for Bayan Telecommunications in the Philippines, and America Movil in Latin America to detect revenue leakage in OSS/BSS systems.
- Design and implement reconciliation processes for Voice/SMS/Data usage and customer records across OSS/BSS systems, improving data integrity and revenue tracking.
- Develop a Fraud Management System for BSNL, India, to detect fraudulent activities by analyzing CDRs, billing data, and service history using Neural Technologies' Minotaur Fraud Management system.

projects.title: Medical Assistant
projects.description: As an AI specialist, your task is to develop a RAG-based AI solution using renowned medical manuals to address healthcare challenges. The objective is to understand information overload, apply AI techniques to streamline decision-making, analyze its impact on diagnostics and patient outcomes, evaluate its potential to standardize care practices, and create a functional prototype demonstrating its feasibility and effectiveness.

projects.title: ReneWind
projects.description: The project aims to create and improve classification models for ReneWind's wind turbine generator failures, enabling proactive maintenance and cost reduction. The models use sensor data to identify potential failures, minimizing false negatives and ensuring turbine repairs before breakdown. The final models are chosen based on their ability to accurately predict failures, providing insights and recommendations to improve maintenance strategies and cost efficiency in wind energy production.
